title: Configuration constant
statement: For a finite binary Turing machine $M$, define its configuration constant to be the supremum, over all configuration kinds, of the width bound evaluated at $M$’s configuration arity, configuration width, and local update function.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The definitions of configuration arity, configuration width, local update function, and the width-bound function are not included, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be specified here.
